title: Fenrir loader 2020-07-22 virtual-disc launch
summary: Use the existing SAROO launch-service pointer through the loader's original indirect call.
rationale: Optional exact-source profile for this exact official loader delivered from SAROO virtual-disc sectors. The original instruction at 0600DCCA already reads a function pointer through R1 and calls it through R0. Point its 0600DD18 literal to SAROO's existing 02000F30 export instead of the BIOS0600029C slot; this avoids the old NOP and call-register edits. The whole original raw sector authenticates the edit, and the ISO is retained unchanged with canonical Mode1/2352 conversion recorded separately. This does not intercept reads owned by a physical Fenrir, establish native-CD coexistence, or certify actual Fenrir hardware. That route remains separate.

writes.effect: Select SAROO's published BIOS-CD-command function pointer.
writes.reason: Retain the original MOV.L/JSR sequence and route launch through the existing service.
